text:
Lina: Heads up, publishflow flagged a minor version bump for clients/js even though only generated comments changed. Anyone near the typegen pipeline?
Owen: Seen this before when OpenAPI example blocks reorder. typegen emits different doc comments and regen-check treats it as a change.
Priya: Quick repro: reorder examples in spec -> `yarn typegen` -> diff. Locally fixed by `node scripts/normalize-openapi` first.
Sam: CI excerpt: ```
regen-check failed: typegen output mismatch
diff --git a/clients/js/src/index.ts b/clients/js/src/index.ts
@@ -8,6 +8,10 @@
+  // example (login): new ordering
  export function createClient() {}
```
ci-bot: Build 854900 failed on step "regen-check". Link: https://ci.redwood/854900.
devex-bot: Opened issue #7810 "publishflow: normalize OpenAPI before typegen to avoid examples-only regen diffs" assigned to @Sam and @Priya.
Lina: Proposed fix: add normalization step in publishflow before typegen (hotfix), plus a guard in regen-check to treat example-only diffs as docs-only. Sam, can you hotfix?
Sam: Yup, I'll PR a one-liner to run `node scripts/normalize-openapi.js` in the publish job and add a unit that shuffles examples. ETA 90m.
Priya: I'll draft the regen-check guard but will make it conservative so it doesn't mask signature/type changes.
Lina: Also watch sample-app CI for auth/retry flakiness after any publish/revert. We had a flaky retry test last minor bump. If any flakes show, drop them here. :eyes:
